english_title: Recognising and Responding to The Day of the Week
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: numbers, dates & time — the day of the week
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the day of the week; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Mr James asks Ms Lan what day it is today.
context_note_vi: Anh James hỏi chị Lan hôm nay thứ mấy.

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.english: Lan, what day is today, do you know?
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, hôm nay thứ mấy, chị biết không?

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.vietnamese: Thứ Ba à. Cảm ơn chị.
